items.title: Louis Gallaud Interview, 1960-03-18
items.q: I knew where he was living at though... He was living around there, right around the corner from there

ctx.x: No, I used to know, I knew where he was living at though. He was living around there, right around the corner from there, what I'm talking about. He was living on the corner I think. Corner in Hillary.
Did you ever hear another fellow, Alfred Wilson, a piano player in the district on Basin Street there? It was way back maybe around 1910 to 15 along that period.
Well, Alfred, Alfred William, he was playing with a violin player and a bass and a guitar at that time. Right on the corner, let's see now.
